name: blyt
description: Blyt fantasy console — build, run, and debug carts in VS Code

blyt.sdkDir.description: Path to the blyt SDK directory (contains bin/blyt, bin/blytplay, bin/blyt-clang, etc.). Also settable via the BLYT_SDK_DIR environment variable.

blyt.traceChannels.description: BLYT_TRACE channels passed (via --trace) to debug sessions: comma list of gdb,dap,lifecycle,api,frame, or "all". Empty disables tracing.

cart.description: Path to the compiled .blyt cart file. Auto-detected from the workspace if omitted. The debugger auto-detects Lua vs native carts.

mode.description: Run mode. Omit for WASM (default): cart opens in a VS Code panel. native: cart opens in an external SDL2 window (Ctrl+F5 = blytplay, F5 = blytdebug). build/build-debug: compile without launching.

command.description: The blyt command to run (build, run)
